htmlLang.note: The same on every route; nothing sets it per page.

title.how: The template's index.html has a fixed <title>; React 19 renders a <title> from a component.
title.note: A title per page exists only once JavaScript has run.

description.how: A <meta name="description"> rendered from a component, which React 19 puts in the head.
description.note: In a client-only app it is not in the HTML the server sends. React 19 puts a tag rendered from a component in the head, but the tag itself is written by hand.

contentInHtml.how: The template is a client-only app: the server sends an empty <div id="root">.
contentInHtml.note: Vite's server rendering is a low-level API wired up by hand.

openGraph.note: Link previews run no JavaScript, so in a client-only app they never see it. React 19 puts a tag rendered from a component in the head, but the tag itself is written by hand.

csp.how: The policy written by hand as a header or meta tag.
csp.note: html.cspNonce only adds a nonce to Vite's own tags.

frameOptions.how: A header set on the host or server.

robots.how: A robots.txt written by hand in public/.

sitemap.how: Written by hand in public/, or a third-party plugin.

canonical.how: A <link rel="canonical"> rendered from a component.
canonical.note: In a client-only app it is not in the HTML the server sends. React 19 puts a tag rendered from a component in the head, but the tag itself is written by hand.

jsonLd.how: A <script type="application/ld+json"> written by hand in JSX.
